vision.name: Namekian Planetary Countdown
vision.text:
(Limit 1 per deck.)
[Instant] POWER: Use when you would lose by Survival Victory during combat. You cannot lose the game during this action. At the end of this action, shuffle the bottom 5 cards of your discard pile into your Life Deck.
(Banish after use.)
(Created by Tim Batow, OP1 Grand Kai Champion)
